opening.argument: The video centers on an educational discussion of six altcoins, using market-cycle analysis to explain why they may be positioned for the next phase of the market. The speaker also warns that the discussion is not financial advice and urges viewers to do their own research. A separate MEXC signup offer is plainly promotional, but the supplied evidence does not establish deceptive terms, unsafe destination behavior, payment loss, or any resulting outcome. The request for viewer comments is ordinary audience engagement, not a basis for treating the market analysis as a deceptive offer.
